```{r}
############ revisions regarding phylogenetic correction for genomic features ############ 
## 1. check if predictor is normally distributed
## 2. box-cox transform if necessary
## 3. run phylogenetic logistic regression model

# load tree
tree=read.tree("data/figure_data/protein.tre.treefile")

# prune tree, only keep isolates with AA_auxo data
genomes_with_data <- isfinder_count %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(AAs_auxo) & !is.na(count_norm), Type!="Polymorphism") %>%
    dplyr::pull(genome)
pruned_tree <- drop.tip(tree, setdiff(tree$tip.label, genomes_with_data))

# rescale tree to 1 before running pglm NOTE: this does not affect significance, only alpha estimate
tree_height <- max(node.depth.edgelength(pruned_tree))
scaled_tree = pruned_tree
# Rescale all branch lengths proportionally
scaled_tree$edge.length <- scaled_tree$edge.length / tree_height

############ normalized insertion sequences ############ looks like it is still signifcant after phylo correction

# filter data to keep only genomes in pruned tree
filtered_data <- isfinder_count %>% dplyr::filter(genome %in% pruned_tree$tip.label)

# check normality of data
shapiro.test(filtered_data$count_norm)

# boxcox transform to make more normal
boxcox(lm(filtered_data$count_norm~1), lambda = seq(-2, 2, length.out = 100)) ->boxcox_val

# find lambda value at the maximum of the profile log-likelihood
boxcox_val$x[which.max(boxcox_val$y)] -> lambda

# box-cox transform using lambda value
boxcox_transform <- function(x, lambda) {
     if (lambda == 0) {
         return(log(x))
     } else {
         return((x^lambda - 1) / lambda)
     }
 }

y_transformed <- boxcox_transform(filtered_data$count_norm, lambda)

# looks more normally distributed than before
hist(filtered_data$count_norm)
hist(y_transformed)

# still not fully normal but looks better distributed
shapiro.test(y_transformed)

# run phylogenetic correction model
model <- phyloglm(data = cbind(filtered_data,y_transformed)%>% column_to_rownames("genome"),AAs_auxo ~ y_transformed, phy = pruned_tree, method = "logistic_MPLE")

# weak phylogenetic signal, box-cox transformed normalized number of IS is statistically signifcant 
summary(model)

# CI
set.seed(42)  # reproducibility: fixed seed for bootstrap/sampling
boot <- phyloglm(data = cbind(filtered_data,y_transformed)%>% column_to_rownames("genome"),AAs_auxo ~ y_transformed, phy = pruned_tree, method = "logistic_MPLE",boot=1000)

boot$bootstrap %>% as.data.frame() %>% mutate(half_life=log(2)/alpha) ->boot_alpha

# alpha
median(boot_alpha$alpha)
quantile(boot_alpha$alpha, probs = c(0.025, 0.975))

# half life
median(boot_alpha$half_life)
quantile(boot_alpha$half_life, probs = c(0.025, 0.975))

ggplot(boot_alpha) + geom_density(aes(x=half_life)) + scale_x_log10()

############ repeat for genome streamlining ############ count_norm is marginally not signifcant but alpha is very high suggesting weak phylogenetic signal

filtered_data_streamlining <- genes_count %>% dplyr::filter(genome %in% pruned_tree$tip.label)

# looks better than IS_count but still not normally distributed
hist(filtered_data_streamlining$count_norm)
shapiro.test(filtered_data_streamlining$count_norm)

# boxcox transform to make more normal
boxcox(lm(filtered_data_streamlining$count_norm~1),lambda = seq(0, 10, 0.01)) ->boxcox_val_streamlining
# find lambda value
boxcox_val_streamlining$x[which.max(boxcox_val_streamlining$y)] -> lambda_streamlining
# boxcox transform using lamda value collapses all variance
y_transformed_streamlining <- boxcox_transform(filtered_data_streamlining$count_norm, lambda_streamlining)
# more normally but not fully
hist(y_transformed_streamlining)
shapiro.test(y_transformed_streamlining)

# run phylogenetic correction model
model <- phyloglm(data = cbind(filtered_data_streamlining,y_transformed_streamlining)%>% column_to_rownames("genome"),AAs_auxo ~ y_transformed_streamlining, phy = scaled_tree, method = "logistic_MPLE")

# weak phylogenetic signal, box-cox transformed normalized number
summary(model)

# very high value i.e. close to -4 suggests low phylogenetic structure
-log(73.14562)

# very low half-life
log(2)/73.14562

# CI
set.seed(42)  # reproducibility: fixed seed for bootstrap/sampling
boot_2 <- phyloglm(data = cbind(filtered_data_streamlining,y_transformed_streamlining)%>% column_to_rownames("genome"),AAs_auxo ~ y_transformed_streamlining, phy = scaled_tree, method = "logistic_MPLE",boot=1000)

boot_2$bootstrap %>% as.data.frame() %>% mutate(half_life=log(2)/alpha) ->boot_2_alpha

quantile(boot_2_alpha$alpha, probs = c(0.025, 0.975))

median(boot_2_alpha$half_life)
quantile(boot_2_alpha$half_life, probs = c(0.025, 0.975))

ggplot(boot_2_alpha) + geom_density(aes(x=half_life)) + scale_x_log10()

############ repeat for IS in annotated genes ############ 

filtered_data_eggnog_IS <- eggnog_IS_count %>% mutate(count_norm = 1000000*count/size) %>% dplyr::filter(genome %in% pruned_tree$tip.label)
  
# skewed data
hist(filtered_data_eggnog_IS$count_norm)
shapiro.test(filtered_data_eggnog_IS$count_norm)

# boxcox transform to make more normal
boxcox(lm(filtered_data_eggnog_IS$count_norm~1),lambda = seq(-5, 5, 0.1)) ->boxcox_val_eggnog_IS
# find lambda value
boxcox_val_eggnog_IS$x[which.max(boxcox_val_eggnog_IS$y)] -> lambda_eggnog_IS
# boxcox transform using lamda value collapses all variance
y_transformed_eggnog_IS <- boxcox_transform(filtered_data_eggnog_IS$count_norm, lambda_eggnog_IS)
# normally distributed after transform
hist(y_transformed_eggnog_IS)
shapiro.test(y_transformed_eggnog_IS)

# run phylogenetic correction model
model <- phyloglm(data = cbind(filtered_data_eggnog_IS,y_transformed_eggnog_IS)%>% column_to_rownames("genome"),AAs_auxo ~ y_transformed_eggnog_IS, phy = scaled_tree, method = "logistic_MPLE")

# weak phylogenetic signal, box-cox transformed normalized number
summary(model)

# very low phylogenetic halflife
log(2)/model$alpha

# CI
set.seed(42)  # reproducibility: fixed seed for bootstrap/sampling
boot_3 <- phyloglm(data = cbind(filtered_data_eggnog_IS,y_transformed_eggnog_IS)%>% column_to_rownames("genome"),AAs_auxo ~ y_transformed_eggnog_IS, phy = scaled_tree, method = "logistic_MPLE",boot=1000)

boot_3$bootstrap %>% as.data.frame() %>% mutate(half_life=log(2)/alpha) ->boot_3_alpha

quantile(boot_3_alpha$alpha, probs = c(0.025, 0.975))

median(boot_3_alpha$half_life)
quantile(boot_3_alpha$half_life, probs = c(0.025, 0.975))

ggplot(boot_3_alpha) + geom_density(aes(x=half_life)) + scale_x_log10()

############ repeat for IS in amino acid annotated genes ############ 
 
filtered_data_eggnog_IS_AA <- eggnog_IS_AA_count %>% mutate(count_norm = 1000000*count/size) %>% dplyr::filter(genome %in% pruned_tree$tip.label)

# skewed data
hist(filtered_data_eggnog_IS_AA$count_norm)
shapiro.test(filtered_data_eggnog_IS_AA$count_norm)

# boxcox transform to make more normal
boxcox(lm(filtered_data_eggnog_IS_AA$count_norm+1~1),lambda = seq(-5, 5, 0.1)) -> boxcox_val_eggnog_IS_AA
# find lambda value
boxcox_val_eggnog_IS_AA$x[which.max(boxcox_val_eggnog_IS_AA$y)] -> lambda_eggnog_IS_AA
# boxcox transform using lamda value collapses all variance
y_transformed_eggnog_IS_AA <- boxcox_transform(filtered_data_eggnog_IS_AA$count_norm+1, lambda_eggnog_IS_AA)
# not normally distributed after transform
hist(y_transformed_eggnog_IS_AA)
shapiro.test(y_transformed_eggnog_IS_AA)

# run phylogenetic correction model
model <- phyloglm(data = cbind(filtered_data_eggnog_IS_AA,y_transformed_eggnog_IS_AA)%>% column_to_rownames("genome"),AAs_auxo ~ y_transformed_eggnog_IS_AA, phy = scaled_tree, method = "logistic_MPLE")

# weak phylogenetic signal, box-cox transformed normalized number
summary(model)

# very low phylogenetic halflife
log(2)/model$alpha

# CI
set.seed(42)  # reproducibility: fixed seed for bootstrap/sampling
boot_4 <- phyloglm(data = cbind(filtered_data_eggnog_IS_AA,y_transformed_eggnog_IS_AA)%>% column_to_rownames("genome"),AAs_auxo ~ y_transformed_eggnog_IS_AA, phy = scaled_tree, method = "logistic_MPLE",boot=1000)

boot_4$bootstrap %>% as.data.frame() %>% mutate(half_life=log(2)/alpha) ->boot_4_alpha

quantile(boot_4_alpha$alpha, probs = c(0.025, 0.975))

median(boot_4_alpha$half_life)
quantile(boot_4_alpha$half_life, probs = c(0.025, 0.975))

ggplot(boot_4_alpha) + geom_density(aes(x=half_life)) + scale_x_log10()

############ repeat for differentially abundant genes? ############ 
### MAYBE THIS NEEDS TO BE DONE PER COG RATHER THAN PER GENE (Preferred_name)
### e.g. COG1748 would capture (lysDH, LYS1, lyS1, -) which all correspond to:
#.  COG1748: Lys9 
#.  Saccharopine dehydrogenase, NADP-dependent [Amino acid transport and metabolism]
#.  Saccharopine dehydrogenase, NADP-dependent is part of the Pathway/BioSystem: Lysine biosynthesis
#. need to parse eggnog annotations to extract root COG and repeat procedure based on that, should
#. also be much quicker to run

eggnog %>% group_by(genome,Preferred_name) %>% summarise(count=n()) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = "Preferred_name",values_from = "count",values_fill = 0) %>% pivot_longer(!genome,names_to = "Preferred_name",values_to = "count") %>% left_join(.,checkm) %>% drop_na() %>% ungroup() %>% mutate(presence=ifelse(count>0,1,0)) -> egg_sum

egg_sum%>%dplyr::select("Preferred_name") %>% unique() -> gene_list

eggnog %>% mutate(cog=gsub("@.*$","",eggNOG_OGs)) %>% group_by(genome,cog) %>% summarise(count=n()) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = "cog",values_from = "count",values_fill = 0) %>% pivot_longer(!genome,names_to = "cog",values_to = "count") %>% left_join(.,checkm) %>% drop_na() %>% ungroup() %>% mutate(presence=ifelse(count>0,1,0)) -> egg_sum_cog

egg_sum_cog %>% ungroup() %>% dplyr::select(cog) %>% unique() -> cog_list

results <- data.frame(
  gene = character(),
  p.value = numeric(),
  alpha = numeric(),
  alpha_low= numeric(),
  alpha_high=numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)


for (i in seq_along(gene_list$Preferred_name)) {

gene= gene_list$Preferred_name[i]
data=egg_sum%>% filter(Preferred_name==gene,genome %in% scaled_tree$tip.label) %>% column_to_rownames("genome")

 if (length(unique(data$presence)) < 2 || length(unique(data$AAs_auxo)) < 2) {
    next  # skip genes without variability
  }

set.seed(42)  # reproducibility: fixed seed for bootstrap/sampling
phyloglm(
    formula = AAs_auxo ~ count, # use presence for binary, count for copy number
    data = data ,
    phy = scaled_tree, method = "logistic_MPLE",boot = 100) -> test
    
sum_test = summary(test)
    #print(gene)
    #print(test$coefficients[2,4])

    results <- rbind(results, data.frame(gene = gene, p.value = sum_test$coefficients[2,6], alpha = test$bootstrap %>% as.data.frame() %>% dplyr::select(alpha) %>% summarize(median=median(alpha)) %>% as.numeric(), alpha_low=test$bootconfint95[1,3],alpha_high=test$bootconfint95[2,3]))
}

results$p.adj <- p.adjust(results$p.value, method = "BH")

write_delim(results,"data/figure_data/genes_plr.tsv")

# The per-gene loop above is slow (a bootstrapped phyloglm per gene). To reproduce the
# downstream summaries and Supplementary Fig. 11 without re-running it, load the committed
# results instead:
# results <- read.delim("data/figure_data/genes_plr.tsv")

# results_backup = results

# get some number for revisions
results %>% filter(p.value<0.05) %>% dim() # 537 genes
results %>% filter(p.value<0.05) %>% left_join(.,diff_genes%>% rename(gene=Preferred_name)) %>% drop_na() %>% dim() # 209 genes from the 260 original
# including glnA2 , glnA4, gluA, gluB, gluC, lysX, proX, proZ, trpE, pepO

# use media alpha/phylogenetic halflife to filter 260 genes
diff_genes = read.delim("data/figure_data/diff_genes.tsv")

diff_genes %>% rename(gene=Preferred_name) %>% left_join(.,results %>% mutate(phy_hl_median=log(2)/alpha, phy_hl_low=log(2)/alpha_low, phy_hl_high=log(2)/alpha_high)) %>% View()

# vast majority of 260 IDd genes have half-life less than 0.1, suggesting weak phylogenetic strucutre even tho underpowered stat test (no significant pvals after adjusting)
ggplot(diff_genes %>% rename(gene=Preferred_name) %>% 
         left_join(.,results %>% mutate(phy_hl_median=log(2)/alpha, phy_hl_low=log(2)/alpha_low, phy_hl_high=log(2)/alpha_high))) + 
  geom_density(aes(x=phy_hl_median)) + scale_x_log10()

AA_KEGG_modules_ID = c("M00020","M00018","M00021","M00338","M00609","M00017","M00019","M00535","M00570","M00432","M00016","M00525","M00526","M00527","M00030","M00433","M00031","M00844","M00845","M00015","M00026","M00022","M00023","M00024","M00910","M00025","M00040")

# aa metabolism genes have less phylogenetic strucutre than other genes
ggplot(results %>% 
           mutate(phy_hl_median=log(2)/alpha,
                  phy_hl_low=log(2)/alpha_low,
                  phy_hl_high=log(2)/alpha_high) %>% left_join(aa_kegg %>% rename(gene=Preferred_name) %>% mutate(gene_cat=ifelse(is.na(KEGG_Module),"other","AA")))) + 
    geom_boxplot(aes(y=phy_hl_median,x=gene_cat))+
    stat_compare_means(aes(x = gene_cat, y = phy_hl_median), 
                       method = "wilcox.test", 
                       label = "p.format") + scale_y_log10()

# diff genes have lower unadjustd p val compared to other genes
ggplot(results %>% 
           mutate(group=ifelse(gene%in%diff_genes$Preferred_name,"Enriched/depleted without phylogenetic correction","Other"))) + 
    geom_boxplot(aes(y=p.value,x=group),alpha=1,outlier.alpha = 0) + geom_jitter(aes(y=p.value,x=group),alpha=0.1) + 
  ylab("P-value of phyloglm model (not adjusted for multiple hypothesis testing)") + xlab("Gene type") + 
    stat_compare_means(aes(x = group, y = p.value), 
                       method = "wilcox.test", 
                       label = "p.format") + scale_y_log10() + theme_bw() + 
  theme(panel.grid.major=element_blank(),panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

## update final version
# get stat test
results %>% 
           mutate(group=ifelse(gene%in%diff_genes$Preferred_name,"Enriched/depleted without phylogenetic correction","Other")) %>% 
  wilcox_test(p.value ~ group,p.adjust.method="BH") %>%
    add_significance() -> stat.test
stat.test %>% add_xy_position(x = "group") -> stat.test
stat.test[1,9] = 0.15
#plot
ggplot(results %>% 
           mutate(group=ifelse(gene%in%diff_genes$Preferred_name,"Enriched/depleted without phylogenetic correction","Other"))) + 
  geom_jitter(aes(y=p.value,x=group,color=group),alpha=0.8) + 
    geom_boxplot(aes(y=p.value,x=group,fill=group),alpha=0.5,outlier.alpha = 0) + 
  ylab("P-value of phyloglm model (not adjusted for multiple hypothesis testing)") + xlab("Gene type") +  scale_y_log10() + theme_bw() + 
  theme(panel.grid.major=element_blank(),panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),legend.position = "none")  + scale_fill_manual(values=c("#DAC883","gray")) + scale_color_manual(values=c("#DAC883","gray")) + stat_pvalue_manual(stat.test, label = "p.signif")


ggsave("outputs/sup_figS11.pdf",height=6, width = 6)
ggsave("outputs/sup_figS11.png",height=6, width = 6)

#ggsave("outputs/sup_figS11.pdf",height=3.2, width = 5)
#ggsave("outputs/sup_figS11.png",height=3.2, width = 5)

# aa metabolism genes have lower unadjustd p val compared to other genes
ggplot(results %>% 
           mutate(phy_hl_median=log(2)/alpha,
                  phy_hl_low=log(2)/alpha_low,
                  phy_hl_high=log(2)/alpha_high) %>% left_join(aa_kegg %>% rename(gene=Preferred_name) %>% mutate(gene_cat=ifelse(is.na(KEGG_Module),"other","AA")))) + 
    geom_boxplot(aes(y=p.value,x=gene_cat))+
    stat_compare_means(aes(x = gene_cat, y = p.value), 
                       method = "wilcox.test", 
                       label = "p.format") + scale_y_log10()

# discrepancy found between 1st auxo experiment (general) and 2nd specific auxo experiment
auxolab %>% mutate(auxo_lab=as.numeric(auxo_lab)-1) %>% filter(!grepl("_auxo",metabolite)) %>% group_by(Sample_ID) %>% summarize(count=sum(auxo_lab)) %>% left_join(auxolab %>% filter(metabolite=="AAs_auxo") %>% dplyr::select(Sample_ID,auxo_lab) %>% unique()) %>% mutate(count=ifelse(count>0,1,0),agreement=ifelse(count==auxo_lab,1,0),how=ifelse(count>as.numeric(auxo_lab)-1,"specific_auxo","general_auxo")) %>% View()
```

```{r}
library(ggtree)
library(ggtreeExtra)
library(ggnewscale)
library(ggrepel)

# go to data folder
# setwd("~/Documents/soil_auxo/manual_curation/protein_phylophlan")  # repointed: run from repo root

# load tree file
tree=read.tree("data/figure_data/protein.tre.treefile")

# create genome metadata from checkm file
grp <- list(isolate = checkm %>% filter(Type=="Isolate") %>% select(genome) %>% as.matrix(),
            metagenomic = checkm %>% filter(Type=="Metagenomic") %>% select(genome) %>% as.matrix(),
            deep_isolate=checkm%>%filter(Type=="Deep_isolate") %>% select(genome) %>% as.matrix(),
            polymorphism=checkm%>%filter(Type=="Polymorphism") %>% select(genome) %>% as.matrix())

# create genome taxonomy from gtdbtk file
grp2 <- list(p__Thermoproteota = gtdbtk %>% filter(Phylum=="p__Thermoproteota") %>% select(genome) %>% as.matrix(),
            p__Actinobacteriota = gtdbtk %>% filter(Phylum=="p__Actinobacteriota") %>% select(genome) %>% as.matrix(),
            p__Firmicutes = gtdbtk %>%filter(Phylum=="p__Firmicutes") %>% select(genome) %>% as.matrix(),
            p__Proteobacteria=gtdbtk %>%filter(Phylum=="p__Proteobacteria") %>% select(genome) %>% as.matrix(),
            p__Bacteroidota = gtdbtk %>% filter(Phylum=="p__Bacteroidota") %>% select(genome) %>% as.matrix(),
            p__Myxococcota = gtdbtk %>% filter(Phylum=="p__Myxococcota") %>% select(genome) %>% as.matrix(),
            p__Verrucomicrobiota=gtdbtk %>%filter(Phylum=="p__Verrucomicrobiota") %>% select(genome) %>% as.matrix(),
            p__Gemmatimonadota=gtdbtk %>%filter(Phylum=="p__Gemmatimonadota") %>% select(genome) %>% as.matrix(),
            p__Planctomycetota = gtdbtk %>% filter(Phylum=="p__Planctomycetota") %>% select(genome) %>% as.matrix(),
            p__Tectomicrobia = gtdbtk %>% filter(Phylum=="p__Tectomicrobia") %>% select(genome) %>% as.matrix(),
            p__Nitrospirota=gtdbtk %>%filter(Phylum=="p__Nitrospirota") %>% select(genome) %>% as.matrix())

# plot sample type
groupOTU(ggtree(tree,layout = "circular") + geom_tiplab(aes(angle=angle),hjust = -0.25), grp, 'Type') + aes(color=Type) +
    theme(legend.position="right")

# plot taxonomy phylum level
groupOTU(ggtree(tree,layout = "circular") + geom_tiplab(aes(angle=angle),hjust = -0.25), grp2, 'Phylum') + aes(color=Phylum) +
    theme(legend.position="right")

# all in one
ggtree(tree,layout = "circular") %<+% gtdbtk  + geom_tiplab(aes(angle=angle),hjust = -0.25) +geom_tippoint(aes(shape = Type, color = Phylum))
```

```{r}
# TRANSPOSONS - ISfinder DB search

#load hits
isfinder_hits = read.delim("data/annotations/ISfinder_k1000.tsv") %>%
  mutate(genome=gsub("_shovill.*$","_shovill",reference),genome=gsub("_NODE.*$","",genome),genome=gsub("_k.*$","",genome)) %>%
  left_join(.,checkm,by="genome")

# get count of hits across genomes for statistical testing
isfinder_hits %>% group_by(genome)%>% filter(seqid>=40) %>% dplyr::summarize(count=n()) %>% full_join(checkm,by="genome") %>% mutate_at("count", ~replace_na(.,0)) %>% mutate(count_norm=count/size) -> isfinder_count
isfinder_hits%>% filter(seqid>=40) %>% group_by(genome,query) %>% dplyr::summarize(count=n()) -> isfinder_count_per

#### WE DONT YET HAVE PLOT FOR INSERTION SEQS!!!

ggplot(isfinder_count %>% mutate(AAs_auxo=ifelse(is.na(AAs_auxo),"Not assayed",ifelse(AAs_auxo==1,"Auxotroph","Prototroph")),AAs_auxo=factor(AAs_auxo,levels=c("Not assayed","Prototroph","Auxotroph")),count_norm=1000000*count_norm),aes(x=AAs_auxo,y=count_norm)) + geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0,alpha=0.8) + geom_jitter(alpha=0.5) + xlab("Amino acid auxotrophy status") + ylab(expression(Insertion~sequences~(Mbp^-1))) -> bxpIS
isfinder_count %>% mutate(AAs_auxo=ifelse(is.na(AAs_auxo),"Not assayed",ifelse(AAs_auxo==1,"Auxotroph","Prototroph")),AAs_auxo=factor(AAs_auxo,levels=c("Not assayed","Prototroph","Auxotroph")),count_norm=1000000*count_norm) %>% ungroup() %>% 
    wilcox_test(count_norm ~ AAs_auxo,p.adjust.method="BH") %>%
    add_significance() -> stat.test
stat.test %>% add_xy_position(x = "AAs_auxo") -> stat.test
bxpIS + stat_pvalue_manual(stat.test, label = "p.adj") + theme_bw() -> bxpIS

# get mdian,iqr of seqid, only considering hits with >40% seqid
isfinder_hits %>% filter(seqid>=40) %>% summarize(median=median(seqid),iqr=IQR(seqid))

# get median,iqr of normalisd IS
isfinder_count %>% mutate(AAs_auxo=ifelse(is.na(AAs_auxo),"Not assayed",ifelse(AAs_auxo==1,"Auxotroph","Prototroph")),AAs_auxo=factor(AAs_auxo,levels=c("Not assayed","Prototroph","Auxotroph")),count_norm=1000000*count_norm) %>% summarize(median=median(count_norm),iqr=IQR(count_norm))

# get median,iqr of normalisd IS for auxo/proto
```

```{r}
#with ggtreeextra
library(ggtree)

# setwd("~/Documents/soil_auxo/manual_curation/protein_phylophlan")  # repointed: run from repo root

# load tree file
tree=read.tree("data/figure_data/protein.tre.treefile")

# We use ggtree to create fan layout tree, add taxonomy data from gtdbtk object
p <- ggtree(tree, layout="circular") %<+% (gtdbtk %>% 
                                             mutate(Type=ifelse(Type!="Metagenomic","Isolate","Metagenomic")) %>% 
                                             rename(`Genome Type`=Type) %>%
                                             mutate(Phylum=gsub("p__","",Phylum))) + 
#  geom_tiplab(aes(angle=angle,label=Genus),size=3,hjust = -0.15) + # this adds labels to tips, makes too cluttered
  geom_tippoint(aes(shape = `Genome Type`, color = Phylum)) + guides(color = guide_legend(ncol = 3), shape = guide_legend(ncol = 2)) +
  scale_color_manual(values=c("#a6cee3","#1f78b4","#b2df8a","#33a02c","#fb9a99","#e31a1c","#fdbf6f","#ff7f00","#cab2d6","#6a3d9a","#b15928"))

p

# Use geom fruit to add heatmap of amino acid experimental hits
p2 <- p + 
      new_scale_fill() +
      geom_fruit(
          data=auxo2%>% rename(Auxotrophy=name,Hit=auxo_lab),
          geom=geom_tile,
          mapping=aes(y=genome, x=Auxotrophy, fill=Auxotrophy ,alpha=Hit),
          offset=0.04,   # The distance between external layers, default is 0.03 times of x range of tree.
          pwidth=0.4 # width of the external layer, default is 0.2 times of x range of tree.
      ) + guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 4), alpha = guide_legend(ncol=2)) + scale_fill_manual(values=c("#8DD3C7", "#FFFFB3", "#BEBADA", "#FB8072", "#80B1D3",
    "#FDB462", "#B3DE69", "#FCCDE5", "#D9D9D9", "#BC80BD",
    "#CCEBC5", "#FFED6F", "#8C8C8C", "#1F78B4", "#33A02C",
    "#E31A1C", "#FF7F00", "#A6CEE3", "#6A3D9A", "#B2DF8A")) + geom_text(x=-1, y=18, label="Lab",angle=-23)

p2

# Use geom fruit to add heatmap of amino acid model predictions
p3 <- p2 + 
      geom_fruit(
          data=auxo2,
          geom=geom_tile,
          mapping=aes(y=genome, x=name, fill=name ,alpha=as.factor(auxo_model)),
          offset=0.08,   # The distance between external layers, default is 0.03 times of x range of tree.
          pwidth=0.4 # width of the external layer, default is 0.2 times of x range of tree.
      ) + geom_text(x=-1.4, y=18, label="GEMs",angle=-23)

p3 

# Use geom fruit to add heatmap of amino acid model predictions and lab agreement/disagreement
p4 <- p3 + 
      new_scale_fill() +
      geom_fruit(
          data=auxo2 %>% left_join(.,metadata,by="Sample_ID") %>% mutate(state=ifelse(agree=="1" & auxo_lab=="1","True Positive",
                                                                              ifelse(agree=="1" & auxo_lab=="0","True Negative",
                                                                                     ifelse(agree=="0" & auxo_lab=="1", "False Negative", "False Positive")))) %>% rename(Result=state),
          geom=geom_tile,
          mapping=aes(y=genome, x=name, fill=Result), alpha=0.75,
          offset=0.08,   # The distance between external layers, default is 0.03 times of x range of tree.
          pwidth=0.4 # width of the external layer, default is 0.2 times of x range of tree.
      )  + scale_fill_manual(values=c("#e41a1c","#377eb8","#4daf4a")) + guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 3)) + geom_text(x=-1.8, y=18, label="Evaluation",angle=-23)

p4
```

```{r}
          axis.params = list(axis="x",title="\n\nMetabolic model\npredictions",title.size=6,text.size=0,vjust=10000,title.height=0.06)
      ) + geom_text(x=-1.8, y=18, label="GEMs",angle=-23) +guides(fill=guide_legend(ncol = 3,title.position="top",title.hjust = 0.5))

p4 

# add ccpa/cody regulators based on eggnog annotations
p5 <- p4 + 
    geom_fruit(
        data=eggnog %>% group_by(genome,Preferred_name) %>% filter(grepl("codY|ccpA|cpdA|carD|catR|hfq$|hprK$",Preferred_name)) %>% summarize(count=n()) %>% rename(Regulators=Preferred_name),
        geom=geom_point(),
        mapping=aes(y=genome, x=Regulators,shape=Regulators,size=4),
        offset=0.02,   # The distance between external layers, default is 0.03 times of x range of tree.
        pwidth=0.1 # width of the external layer, default is 0.2 times of x range of tree.
    ) + scale_shape_manual(values=c(1,2,3,4,5,6,7))+guides(shape=guide_legend(ncol = 1,title.position="top",title.hjust = 0.5,override.aes = list(size=5))) + theme(legend.text = element_text(size=15),legend.title=element_text(size=15))

p5

ggsave("outputs/tree_final.pdf",p5,height = 15,width = 12)
ggsave("outputs/tree_final.png",p5,height = 15,width = 12)

#ggsave("outputs/tree.pdf",p5,height = 14.6,width = 10.4)
#ggsave("outputs/tree.png",p5,height = 14.6,width = 10.4)

# add IS hits on genes, point plot is not a good vis tho
p6 <- p5 + 
    new_scale_fill() +
      geom_fruit(
          data=is_sum%>%group_by(genome) %>% summarize(count=sum(count)),
          geom=geom_barplot(),
          mapping=aes(y=genome,x=count),
          offset=0.04,   # The distance between external layers, default is 0.03 times of x range of tree.
          pwidth=0.4 # width of the external layer, default is 0.2 times of x range of tree.
      )

p6

ggsave("outputs/phylogenetic_tree_v3.pdf",height = 10,width = 16)
ggsave("outputs/phylogenetic_tree_v3.png",height = 10,width = 16)


# Use geom fruit to add heatmap of amino acid model predictions and lab agreement/disagreement
p5 <- p4 + 
      new_scale_fill() +
      geom_fruit(
          data=auxo2 %>% left_join(.,metadata,by="Sample_ID") %>% mutate(state=ifelse(agree=="1" & auxo_lab=="1","True Positive",
                                                                              ifelse(agree=="1" & auxo_lab=="0","True Negative",
                                                                                     ifelse(agree=="0" & auxo_lab=="1", "False Negative", "False Positive")))) %>% rename(Result=state),
          geom=geom_tile,
          mapping=aes(y=genome, x=name, fill=Result),
          offset=0.08,   # The distance between external layers, default is 0.03 times of x range of tree.
          pwidth=0.4 # width of the external layer, default is 0.2 times of x range of tree.
      )  + scale_fill_manual(values=c("#FB8072","#F1F1F1","#A7D3D4")) + guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 3)) + geom_text(x=-2.2, y=18, label="Evaluation",angle=-23)

p5


# Use geom fruit to add presence of regulators ccpa and cody based on eggnog annotation of genomes
p6 <- p5 + 
    new_scale_fill() +
      geom_fruit(
          data=eggnog %>% group_by(genome,Preferred_name) %>% filter(grepl("codY|ccpA",Preferred_name)) %>% summarize(count=n()) %>% rename(Regulators=Preferred_name),
          geom=geom_tile(),
          mapping=aes(y=genome, x=Regulators,fill=Regulators),
          offset=0.08,   # The distance between external layers, default is 0.03 times of x range of tree.
          pwidth=0.025 # width of the external layer, default is 0.2 times of x range of tree.
      ) + guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 2)) + scale_fill_manual(values=(c("#cab2d6","#6a3d9a")))

p6

# Use geom fruit to add plasmid gene hits based on genomad annotations
p7 <- p6 + 
    new_scale_fill() +
      geom_fruit(
          data=genomad_plasmid %>% group_by(genome) %>% summarize(hits=n(),length=sum(length),genes=sum(n_genes)) %>% rename(`Annotated MGE genes`=genes), # renamed just for legend, it is plotting plasmid 
          geom=geom_point(),
          mapping=aes(y=genome, x=1,size=`Annotated MGE genes`),
          offset=0.08,   # The distance between external layers, default is 0.03 times of x range of tree.
          pwidth=0.025 # width of the external layer, default is 0.2 times of x range of tree.
      ) + guides(size=guide_legend(ncol=2)) # + geom_text(x=-1.6, y=5, label="Plasmid",angle=-23)

p7

# Use geom fruit to add virus gene hits based on genomad annotations
p8 <- p7 + 
      geom_fruit(
          data=genomad_virus %>% group_by(genome) %>% summarize(hits=n(),length=sum(length),genes=sum(n_genes))%>% rename(`Virus genes`=genes),
          geom=geom_point(),
          mapping=aes(y=genome, x=1,size=`Virus genes`),
          offset=0.08,   # The distance between external layers, default is 0.03 times of x range of tree.
          pwidth=0.025 # width of the external layer, default is 0.2 times of x range of tree.
      ) # + geom_text(x=1.1, y=2, label="Virus",angle=-23)

p8

ggsave("outputs/phylogenetic_tree.pdf",height = 10,width = 16)
ggsave("outputs/phylogenetic_tree.png",height = 10,width = 16)
```

```{r}

# gant chart for personal background

library(tidyverse)

# load sample timeline data
read.delim("fz_timeline.tsv") -> fzt

# Convert start_year and end_year to Date format
fzt$Start <- as.Date(as.character(fzt$Start), format = "%Y")
fzt$End <- as.Date(as.character(fzt$End), format = "%Y")

# Create the timeline plot
ggplot(fzt) +
    geom_segment(aes(x = Start, xend = End, y = reorder(Country,Start), yend = Country, ,color=City), size = 5) +
    geom_text(aes(x = Start, y = Country, label = Event), vjust = -1, hjust = 0, size = 5) +
    labs(x = "Year", y = "Country", title = "FZ Timeline") +
    scale_x_date(date_labels = "%Y", date_breaks = "1 year") +
    theme_minimal() + 
    scale_color_manual(values=c("#d9d9d9","#8dd3c7","#bebada","#fb8072","#80b1d3","#fdb462","#b3de69","#fccde5","#ffffb3","#bc80bd")) + 
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1,size=14),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size=16),
          legend.text = element_text(size=16),
          axis.title = element_text(size=20),
          title = element_text(size=20),
          legend.title = element_text(size=20))
```
